results.note: an insertion at a region's first line is no longer attributed to that region; it falls through to the last region, changing which region name and rung the edit reports
guarantees line: the '-- no tools: the model saw this file and the two diffs only' suffix appears when tools were on and is missing when they were off
dropped .lower() on the reason's region: a reason whose region differs only in case no longer matches the edit, so the report shows '(no reason given)'
removed guard: endswith('') is always true, so a reason with no path is attached to every edit whose region did not match
